Package Repository

Interface MenuDAO

All Known Implementing Classes:
MenuDAOImpl
public interface MenuDAO
Data Access Object (DAO) for menu-related persistence operations.

Defines methods for retrieving and modifying menu items, recipes, ingredients, and customization data from the underlying database.

Implementations of this interface are responsible for handling all database communication and mapping between database records and model objects.
